Our mission

We show up for kids, and we keep showing up.

Blessed 77 Foundation is a youth-focused nonprofit dedicated to building stronger individuals and communities through mentorship, educational support, mental health care, and after-school programming.

We believe every young person deserves a trusted adult who believes in their potential, access to their own mental wellness, and the resources to reach their full potential. No hoops to jump through, no cost to families. Just people who care, in the neighborhoods that need them.

What we do

Three core programs

01

Mentorship

One-on-one relationships with trained mentors who provide guidance, accountability, and unconditional support. We prioritize mental health, emotional wellness, and trauma-informed care. This is the heart of what we do.

02

After-School Programs

Safe, enriching environments where youth develop academically, socially, and personally. Tutoring, activities, and mental health support throughout.

03

Youth Basketball

Competitive and recreational basketball that teaches discipline, teamwork, and excellence while building confidence and mental resilience.
